pca.method: Patterson et al. (2006) normalisation. PCA computed on a present-day reference panel capped per population; ancient individuals projected onto the resulting SNP loadings with per-sample rescaling for missing genotypes. Projected samples are shrunk slightly toward the origin relative to the reference panel, and this is a visualisation rather than a substitute for a published analysis.
